## Extra Resources/Reading

- [Hadley Wickham: Spreadsheets, bikes, and the accidental empire of R packages](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KxRnZTl2HVY) (YouTube, The Test Set) - Hadley Wickham developed many of the R packages we'll use in this course. Hear the back-story as to how he got started!
- [The Jevons Paradox](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a6sYYrLTOjQ) (YouTube, Hank Green) - Why AI (and statistics) do not generate new information.
- [Data Rectangling](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4MfUCX_KpdE) (YouTube, Jenny Bryan, Plotcon 2016) - The importance of getting data into the right format.
- [Tidy Data, Illustrated](https://allisonhorst.com/other-r-fun) - Handy illustrations explaining the idea of tidy data
